summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $30 million of ordinary shares via Roth Capital Partners and H.C. Wainwright Co. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. The sales will be made under Rule 415(a)(4), with a 3.0% agent commission and no escrow arrangement. The company is an emerging growth company. There are no deal terms to track.
